items.title: Google Ads AI tool copies Search campaigns into 10 new languages
items.excerpt: Google Ads' AI localization tool now copies English (US) Search campaigns into 10 new languages; budgets copy across with no currency conversion, and promised Performance Max support has yet to be confirmed.

items.title: Google AI writes positive-only review summaries into Search ads in 4 markets
items.excerpt: Google is inserting AI-generated, positive-only review summaries into Search ads in four markets. Advertisers cannot edit the text, which Google shows only when it predicts better ad performance; the help page omits opt-out and sourcing details.

history_match.title: Google Ads Text Customization Asset Previews

items.title: Google Ads search terms report adds 4 source columns for AI Max traffic
items.excerpt: For AI Max campaigns, the search terms report now shows match, landing page, headline and description sources beside each query, giving advertisers a view into what Google's AI generated and where it sent traffic.

history_match.title: Google Ads Search Terms and Ad Combinations Report (AI Max)

items.title: Google Ads expands Smart Bidding Exploration to Performance Max and Shopping campaigns
items.excerpt: Google's Smart Bidding Exploration, which lets AI bidding loosen ROAS targets (5-30% tolerance) to chase additional conversions, now extends to Performance Max and Shopping campaigns; portfolio bid strategies switch it off.

history_match.title: Google optimises its own revenue. Advertisers have to optimise theirs

items.title: Q3: Omnicom's Media Business Is Growing, But Is It Agent-Proof?
items.excerpt: If AI agents can plan and buy media, who needs a holding company? The question came up during Omnicom's Q3 earnings call, as agentic buying pressures the holdco media model.

history_match.title: Omnicom Media and Rembrand partner to evolve in-content ad placements

items.title: Cybersecurity bounty hunter says Samsung TVs use AI to record audio and screenshots for ads
items.excerpt: A researcher who reverse-engineered his Samsung TV says it runs an on-device AI model that collects screenshots, skipped-ad behavior and audio via connected soundbars to feed ad targeting. (Off-list: no on-list outlet covered it.)

items.title: China Unveils AI Advertising Governance Framework to Tackle Fake Endorsements and Misleading Content
items.excerpt: A blue book released at the China International Advertising Festival lays out a governance framework for AI-generated ads, including multimodal detection, platform safeguards against fake AI endorsements and stronger consumer protection. (Off-list: no on-list coverage.)
